title.narrative: Scaling-up Shock Responsive Social Protection Project

description.narrative: The development objectives of Scaling Up Shock Responsive Social Protection Project is to protect poor and vulnerable households' consumption in response to shocks in Zambia. This project has one component. The component, Social Cash Transfer (SCT), will finance bi-monthly cash transfers to poor and vulnerable households on the SCT.
To protect poor and vulnerable households' consumption in response to shocks in Zambia

comment.narrative: Exceeded target by 173 percent. This indicator is measured as the number foundational SCT households multiplied by the average household size (5.2) as per the DHS 2018, and multiplied by the percentage of households eating more than one meal per day as a result of recieving SCT benefits. An impact evaluation of the SCT revealed that 41 percent of SCT households ate more than one meal per day

SCT beneficiary households receiving payments on time

comment.narrative: While the project observed timely payments in 2023, the value declined in 2024 due to the fiscal pressures on the GRZ resulting from the significant drought response and reduced revenues, leading to delayed disbursement of funds from Treasury. These factors also contributed to delayed payments in early 2025, though the duration of delay has improved. Furthermore, in the last July/August 2025 payment cycle, 74 percent of payments were made on-time. This improvement is expected to continue in the upcoming payment cycles.
